defects: (a) THE SEAT`S: A STREAM EDIT OF A SHARED TOOL. One rename inside tools/act_root.py was made by `sed -i` while the repair was drafted, against the ferry`s line that edits go through the Edit tool and not a stream edit; the rest of the repair went through the Edit tool, and the commit (relay 60e1adf4) carries the whole.

(b) THE SEAT`S: A PROMPT MISCOUNTED. The CRLF prompt said 82 banks over b624-b643; the verify counts 85 (4 in each of seventeen acts, 6, 6 and 5 in three). The author`s rule does not depend on the figure; the bank and this record carry 85.

(c) THE SEAT`S: COMPONENT 0 OUT OF ITS WRITTEN ORDER. The ferry lists every test file run before the repairs; the seat committed the chain-at-commit repair, the additive arm and the watchdog stop first and ran the test files after, so the step-zero bank holds the repaired tools` tests among its runs.

(d) THE SEAT`S: THE WATCHDOG`S RACE, FOUND AT STEP ZERO. test_build_watch_b644.py read 2 of 3 at its first step-zero run (a stop`s line written by the sampler thread after the watchdog exited); the fix (relay e0cc0904, the sampler joined before EXIT) committed alone and the test 3 of 3 three times; the runner bank keeps the re-run alone, the first run`s figure stated here.

(e) THE SEAT`S: A STRAY FILE IN A REPOSITORY TREE. The first detached launch passed a module name with spaces through Start-Process, which split it, and the watchdog opened its log at a relative path, creating an empty D:\relay\SEC; it was verified empty and deleted on its absolute path, and the launch repeated with no spaced argument.

(f) THE SEAT`S: A CONCURRENT SEARCH DURING A WATCHED BUILD. A git grep over relay`s data ran while RestrictedTensorLayer1`s first attempt compiled; that attempt was stopped at a sample (2161 MB) when lean`s own working set was 93 MB, so the seat`s search shares the fall; the retry ran alone and fell at 2530 MB.
(g) THE SEAT`S: THE STEP-ZERO CENSUSES, PINS AND READS BANKED LATE. They were run after Component 7 (relay 7d8acfe3), not at step zero, the reads made at step zero and printed then.

(h) THE SEAT`S: TOOLING MISSES BEFORE ANY BANK. The composer`s format string twice bound `%` to its last literal alone (raised, nothing written); the recount`s first dry run counted every SaltCheck declaration as evidence (1943, then 45 once restricted to the premise`s direct uses); the lattice`s REGISTER pattern widened by LiCoeff and Register4 after its first dry run; the patch plan`s first dry wording named the nearest heading and a wrong position for the class-numbering note; a git add named a dry-only bank and staged nothing; each repaired before its bank landed.

(i) THE INSTRUMENT`S, CARRIED: b639`s LABEL READER. tools/b639_record.py :869-:871 took ONE_PAGE_PROOF`s first version string, SIDE-kernel`s tag v1.3, for its label; b641 resolved v1.3.1 on it and (R254)(7) ordered it, neither reading the line -- the navigator`s share named, by the author`s answer; ONE_PAGE_PROOF takes v1.0.1 and W-ORD-LABEL-READER is entered.

(j) THE NAVIGATOR`S: THE SEAM CALLED CITED. The author`s sentence for the description called the seam cited; the kernel compiles it (rh_strip_imp_rh_holds, DERIVES at the standard three), so the text says compiled under the fact clause, and the author`s answer let compiled stand, the sentence recorded as the navigator`s.

(k) THE SEAT`S: THE FIRST DESCRIPTION CARRIED A CONTRADICTION. Its claim part called h2_sign the one open premise beside some twenty OPEN premises in its assumption part; the second reader found it; the path print (no OPEN premise on the path from h2_sign to RH) and fourteen further repairs followed on the author`s word, each committed alone.

(l) THE SEAT`S: THE FIRST CENSUS AT v0.7.1 CARRIED FOUR FAULTS. The glossary`s refined HINGE entry named its own date as the entry it replaced; two definitions of own evidence; SatisfiesCWeil WITNESSED beside UNWITNESSED; the hold undefined -- the hinge reader found them; regenerated on the author`s word (PLACE-papers 508856c) and the pages re-emitted again.

(m) THE NAVIGATOR`S: A ROSTER ORDER WITH NO OBJECT. (R254)(7) ordered the mirror`s roster edited to the patch labels; the roster carries paths without labels and none of the companions; the author`s answer appended the seven and both census editions.

(n) THE SERVICE`S: FOUR UPLOADS FAILED AFTER THEIR OLD FILES WERE DELETED. The draft`s update returned HTTP 504 or 502 on four companions, the route having deleted each old file first, so the draft held ten files until the retry (four PUTs, 201 each, nothing deleted); the first read-back met three download 504s and is kept as _attempt1; the second read every file at its digest.
